name: Warehouse-Breach-View-From-Entrance
visual_desc: ROOM SIZE: wrecked medium warehouse bay fragment ~10×8 m usable, partial roof, 4 m remaining walls. NORTH WALL (entrance/breach): large irregular wall breach open to street light, jagged brick, sand and rubble threshold — primary entry for troops. SOUTH WALL (opposite): collapsed shelving, toppled cardboard and plastic crates, gray dust, far intact loading door jammed. EAST WALL (right when entering): cracked concrete wall, old safety posters peeled, steel column bent. WEST WALL (left when entering): partial interior partition, fire-black tongue marks, empty pallet stack. CENTER: clear dusty floor patch for two kneeling firers, debris ring. CEILING/FLOOR: broken skylight shafts of pale dawn, water-stained concrete floor. SHOW EMPTY WITHOUT PEOPLE. Photoreal destroyed logistics interior. Wrecked warehouse bay used as fire position; irregular wall breach/prolom with broken brick; interior cover for two men; direct 200 m line of sight from breach cover to crab approach path on the street; early-dawn to morning light progression; Lin ends on haunches at the breach with unfired rifle.

anchor_points.axes: X=[0,1] image-left-to-right wall. Y=[0,1] entrance-to-far-wall. Z=[0,1] floor-to-ceiling. View-To-Entrance: x_mirrored = 1 - x (left↔right swap), Y depth reversed.

objects.notes: Full image-right wall plane. Cracked concrete run entrance-to-far. Faces image-left.

objects.label: Collapsed shelving
objects.notes: Along far wall (y≈0.92), slightly image-left of center. Toppled metal shelving wreckage. Faces toward entrance.

objects.notes: Far-side center-right (x≈0.58, y≈0.84). Cardboard and plastic crates spilled in gray dust.

objects.notes: Overhead center (z≈0.96). Broken skylight casting pale dawn shafts onto dusty floor.

zones.label: Breach and rubble threshold entry
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Large irregular wall breach centered on entrance wall; jagged brick edges and rubble threshold in immediate foreground; pale street light pouring in; clear floor patch beyond threshold mid-ground. DEPTH: breach opening foreground → rubble threshold → clear floor patch mid-ground → far shelving/crates background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Breach opening and street light centered in far background; rubble threshold beyond mid-ground toward entrance; camera near far wall with collapsed shelving nearest. DEPTH: far-wall shelving/crates foreground → room mid → rubble threshold → breach opening background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: Breach and rubble on entrance-side edge of frame; clear floor toward center; far wall debris on opposite edge. Image-right wall is far background when viewed from image-left wall. DEPTH along X: image-left partition edge → center clear patch → image-right cracked wall background.

zones.label: Center clear dusty floor firing patch
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Open dusty concrete patch center entrance-side (x≈0.5, y≈0.32) for two kneeling firers; debris ring around it; breach and rubble behind camera toward entrance; far collapsed shelving in background. DEPTH: entrance/rubble behind near plane → clear patch mid-ground → debris ring → far wall crates/shelving background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Clear firing patch in mid-ground center (x_mirrored≈0.5); debris ring around it; far-wall wreckage nearest camera; breach opening centered in background with street light. DEPTH: far-wall shelving foreground → debris ring → clear patch mid-ground → breach entrance background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: Clear patch at mid room depth along lateral view; entrance-side rubble to one edge, far crates to the other; image-left pallets/partition near or behind camera if from left. DEPTH along X: image-left cover → clear patch center → bent column/image-right wall.

zones.label: Image-left partition and pallet cover
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Partial interior partition and fire-black marks on image-left side (x≈0.1–0.14); empty pallet stack farther along image-left (y≈0.62); clear floor patch to image-right of partition; far wall soft in background. DEPTH: entrance-side left wall → partition mid-ground → pallet stack → far wall background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Partition and pallets now on image-right (x_mirrored≈0.88–0.9); far-wall plane nearest camera left-of-center; entrance breach in background. DEPTH: far wall foreground → pallet/partition mid-ground image-right → entrance breach background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: Zone sits near image-left wall; when camera on image-left wall this cover is behind/near camera; when from image-right wall, partition/pallets are far background along X. Entrance-side vs far-side edges set by Y. DEPTH from right: image-right wall → center floor → partition/pallets on image-left background.

zones.label: Image-right cracked wall and bent column
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Cracked concrete image-right wall with peeled safety posters; bent steel column at mid-depth image-right (x≈0.9, y≈0.52); room center clear patch to image-left of column. DEPTH: entrance-side right wall → posters/column mid-ground → far loading-door corner background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Bent column and cracked wall now image-left (x_mirrored≈0.1); far wall nearest camera; entrance breach background center-right. DEPTH: far wall foreground → column/posters mid-ground image-left → entrance background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: From image-left wall looking across: bent column and right wall are far background along X; entrance-side posters vs far-side door jamb separated by Y. DEPTH: image-left edge → center floor → bent column → image-right wall background.

zones.label: Far wall collapsed shelving and crates
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Collapsed shelving along far wall slightly image-left of center; toppled cardboard/plastic crates far-center; jammed loading door far wall image-right; gray dust. DEPTH: entrance → clear patch mid-ground → crates → collapsed shelving and loading door far background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Collapsed shelving and crates in immediate foreground (near camera at far wall); loading door image-left in this view (x_mirrored≈0.22); room opens back to centered breach entrance in bright background. DEPTH: shelving/crates/loading-door foreground → mid room → rubble threshold → breach background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: Far-wall debris along far-side edge of lateral frame; loading door toward image-right-far corner; shelving more center-far. DEPTH along X still wall-to-wall; far-side stack reads as one edge of frame.

zones.label: Broken skylight light pool
zones.visual_disposition_hint: Pale dawn shafts from broken skylight over room center; illuminates dusty clear patch and debris ring from above; partial roof around opening. DEPTH: light falls mid-room on floor patch; entrance dimmer behind camera; far debris half-lit background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_to_entrance: Skylight pool still mid-room overhead; floor highlight between far-wall foreground wreckage and entrance breach glowing in background. DEPTH: far wreckage foreground → lit mid floor → entrance background.
zones.visual_disposition_hint_lateral: Overhead center; light pool marks room middle independent of lateral camera; anchors vertical composition above clear patch.
